description: This file defines the ConfigDependencies class in the Drupal REST module, responsible for calculating and managing dependencies related to REST resource configurations, including handling dependency removal scenarios.

classes.name: ConfigDependencies
classes.description: Calculates REST resource configuration dependencies and manages dependency removal logic within the Drupal REST module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigDependencies object with format and authentication providers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ConfigDependencies using container parameters.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for a given REST resource configuration based on its granularity, returning dependencies keyed by type.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles dependency removal events, delegating to specific methods based on granularity.

methods.name: onDependencyRemovalForMethodGranularity
methods.description: Adjusts configuration when dependencies related to method granularity are removed, potentially modifying supported auth and formats.

methods.name: onDependencyRemovalForResourceGranularity
methods.description: Adjusts configuration when dependencies related to resource granularity are removed, potentially modifying supported auth and formats.
